tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground on every screen, desktop and mobile.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards, the ask bar, sheets, the sidebar, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fill: your own message bubble, hover rows, icon tiles, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-2 and clay-soft. Also the brand mark fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface, surface-2 and clay-soft: metadata, reasons, inactive nav.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.5:1 or better in both themes): eyebrows, placeholders, timestamps. Not on clay-soft; use ink-2 there.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative; never the only signal.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger divider and the border of approval cards and outline buttons. Decorative (1.6:1); never the border that identifies an input. Use line-control for that.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, the ask bar and the ask pill: 3:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: The assistant's accent: the one primary action per card, links, the focus ring, the now marker, the running dot. As text on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.5:1 or better). Not as text on clay-soft.

tokens.name: clay-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a clay button.

tokens.name: clay-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on clay, clay-hover and danger fills (4.8:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: clay-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the current nav item, text selection and the needs-you count. Ink and ink-2 text only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, applied, confirmed. Passes as text and icon on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes. Success and danger are close in lightness, so each always carries a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Shadow mode, paused, held, unconfirmed. Passes as text and icon on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Live mode, failed, outcome unknown, destructive buttons. Passes as text on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes. Always beside a word or icon, because success and danger are close in lightness.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices. Passes as text and icon on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop under sheets, the mobile thread drawer and the command palette.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Data series 1; the 9B stage dot in mail routing.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Data series 2; the kNN stage dot.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Data series 3; the learned stage dot.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Data series 4; the rule stage dot.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Data series 5; the correction stage dot.

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Data series 6; the fallback stage dot.

styles.name: brief
styles.usage: The one headline of the daily brief on desktop. New in this redesign.
styles.sample: Three things need you before your 2:00.

styles.name: brief-sm
styles.usage: The brief headline on mobile. New in this redesign.
styles.sample: Three things need you before your 2:00.

styles.name: voice-h1
styles.usage: Top heading inside an assistant reply.

styles.name: voice-h2
styles.usage: Second heading inside an assistant reply.

styles.name: voice-h3
styles.usage: Third heading inside an assistant reply.

styles.name: voice
styles.usage: Everything the assistant says: replies, the brief paragraph, the draft text inside an approval card.
styles.sample: I filed 14 messages overnight and drafted a reply to Sam.

styles.name: voice-note
styles.usage: Assistant notes between tool steps and agenda annotations.

styles.name: input
styles.usage: What you type and what you said: the ask bar and your message bubble. 16px on mobile so iOS does not zoom.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default interface text: nav items, card titles, buttons.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis in interface text: titles, the current nav item, button labels.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.usage: Dense rows: thread list, trace rows, tabs, reasons.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section labels in ink-3, set uppercase.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Times, amounts, ids, addresses, tool arguments.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Ask bar padding; gap between a card's parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards and sections on a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page zones: brief, needs you, today, done.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top offset of the brief on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The brand mark at 24px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, your message bubble, trace rows, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The ask bar, sheets, the large brand mark.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dots, the send button, the collapsed ask pill.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-dock
tokens.usage: The ask bar, wherever it is docked.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Sheets, the command palette, the mobile thread drawer.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything tappable on mobile.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height on both platforms.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile tab bar height, before the bottom safe area.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Collapsed desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: reading-w
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the reading column: brief, thread, ask bar.

tokens.name: panel-w
tokens.usage: Desktop context panel: the day on home, the work of a thread.

tokens.name: bp-mobile
tokens.usage: Below this width the layout is mobile: tab bar, no sidebar, panel becomes a sheet.

tokens.name: bp-panel
tokens.usage: Below this width the desktop context panel folds behind a button.
